results.problem: Sparse α-navigable graph construction in general metrics
results.quote: For every constant $\alpha\ge 1$ and every constant $\eta\in(0,1)$, there exists a constant $c_\eta>0$ such that it is NP-hard to compute an $(\alpha,2\alpha-\eta)$-bricriteria $c_\eta lnn$-approximation of the sparsest $\alpha$-navigable graph on a metric $(P,d)$ with n points.
